title: Kissed Spicy Vietnamese Baby Plum Tomatoes Com Tam
description: A spicy and savory Vietnamese dish featuring baby plum tomatoes, served in a traditional lacquerware bowl, perfect for a rainy day. This Whole30-friendly recipe combines the freshness of tomatoes with the warmth of spices.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the halved baby plum tomatoes with 1 tablespoon of coconut oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the tomatoes on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 15 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly caramelized.
In a large skillet, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil over medium-high heat.
Add the diced grilled pork to the skillet and cook until it is lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced Thai bird eye chili and garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the fish sauce and lime juice, and cook for 1 minute, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
To assemble the dish, place a portion of the roasted tomatoes in a lacquerware bowl, followed by a spoonful of the pork and sauce mixture.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
